findings.title: [SUPPLY] 3 container image(s) without a digest pin
findings.detail: Pin images by digest (`image@sha256:...`) for reproducible, tamper-evident deploys.

report: Deterministic, LLM-free checks executed on the lab (ci-runner) against the mainecybertech workspace synced to 9c0b88c. Container-image digest pins are the only residual; gitleaks (installed on the lab) reported no committed secret.
